description: This file defines the final class DefaultContext<K> which implements the CommandStrategy.Context<K> interface. It encapsulates a generic state and a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for logging. The class provides a static factory method for instance creation, accessor methods for its fields, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: DefaultContext
classes.description: An immutable class holding context information used for executing CommandStrategies, including a state of generic type K and a DiagnosticLoggingAdapter for logging.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DefaultContext instance with provided state and logging adapter.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the stored state of the context.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Returns the LoggingAdapter used in this context.
